name: AI Ki Kahani: Calculator Se ChatGPT Tak (5 din, 75 saal)
subject: AI ki kahani: shuru se aaj tak - pehle computer se ChatGPT tak

episodes.title: 1950 Ka Sawaal Jo Aaj Aapke Phone Mein Hai: 'Kya Machine Soch Sakti Hai?'
episodes.brief:
ARC 1 — SAPNA (Ep 1 of 5)
0–1.5s HOOK: Phone baj raha hai, unknown number, saaf Hindi mein awaaz… 'Ye insaan nahi, machine hai.' On-screen: 'ChatGPT achanak nahi aaya!' Claim that sounds wrong: 'Ye sawaal 76 saal purana hai.'
1.5–5s SELF-RELEVANCE: 'Aapke phone ka voice assistant, bank ka chatbot — sabki shuruat ek sawaal se hui jo 1950 mein poocha gaya tha.' OPEN LOOP: 'Aur 6 saal baad is cheez ko ek naam mila — wahi naam jo aaj har news mein hai. Ant tak dekho.'
5–12s CONCEPT IN ONE SENTENCE: 'AI ki kahani ek machine ki kahani hai jo pehle sirf jod-ghatana karti thi, aur dheere-dheere insaan jaisi baat karna seekh gayi.'
12–22s REAL-LIFE ANALOGY (Turing Test): 'Parde ke peeche se aapse koi chat kar raha hai. Agar aap pakad hi na pao ki wo insaan hai ya machine — to kya machine "soch" rahi hai?' Alan Turing ne 1950 mein yahi test socha.
22–34s HOW IT WORKS (drawn on whiteboard): 1) Ek parda, ek taraf aap. 2) Peeche do — ek insaan, ek machine. 3) Aap sawaal poochte ho, jawab padhte ho. 4) Agar pehchaan nahi paaye → machine 'pass'.
34–40s CONFLICT: 'Aap soch rahe ho — 1950 mein toh computer kamre jitna bada tha, wo kya sochega?' Win: 'Bilkul! Isliye ye sirf sawaal tha, jawab nahi. Lalaji ka bahi-khata jaisa — jo likha hai bas wahi.'
40–46s PAYOFF (~70%): 1956, Dartmouth Conference, John McCarthy ne naam diya: 'Artificial Intelligence'. 'Wahi naam jo aaj aapke feed par har din hai.'
46–50s LOCAL NEWS EXAMPLE: Oct 2026 — MeitY/IndiaAI Mission ne 20 swadeshi foundation models ko support announce kiya (12 multimodal, 8 small language models) taaki AI Indian bhashayein samjhe (Source: MeitY / PIB, Oct 2026). 'Turing ka sawaal ab Bhojpuri aur Tamil mein poocha ja raha hai.'
50–53s MYTH vs TRUTH: Myth: 'AI 2022 mein ChatGPT ke saath invent hua.' Truth: 'Naam 1956 ka hai, sawaal 1950 ka — lagbhag 70 saal purani kahani.'
53–56s YAAD RAKHO: '1950 — sawaal (Turing). 1956 — naam (McCarthy).' Identity: 'Ab aap 90% logon se zyada jaante ho.'
56–60s SIGN-OFF + SHARE + OPEN LOOP: 'Ye video us dost ko bhejo jo sochta hai AI 2022 mein paida hua.' 'Kal: duniya ka pehla chatbot — aapke dada-dadi ke zamane mein bana tha. Aur log usse apne dil ki baat bataane lage…'
EXAMPLE: Parde ke peeche chat — insaan ya machine? Plus kirana bahi-khata (1950s computer = sirf likha hua hisaab).
VIDEOS/VISUALS: Phone ringing close-up (hands only), retro room-sized computer / blinking panels, punch cards, whiteboard draw of parda + 3 boxes, timeline strip 1950 → 1956 animated, Indian city street with phones, text card 'Artificial Intelligence – 1956'. No faces.
WHY NOW: IndiaAI ke 20 swadeshi models (Oct 2026) har jagah news mein hain; Reels par 'Before ChatGPT' aur 'History of AI in 30 seconds' trend kar rahe hain; comments mein log pooch rahe hain 'ChatGPT se pehle AI tha bhi kya?'

episodes.title: 1966 Ka Chatbot Jisse Log Dil Ki Baat Karne Lage — Phir AI 'So' Kyun Gaya?
episodes.era: 1966–1980s (Arc 1: Sapna — pehla chatbot aur AI Winter)
episodes.brief:
ARC 1 — SAPNA (Ep 2 of 5)
0–1.5s HOOK: Railway helpline par aap Bhojpuri mein bolte ho — bot samajh jaata hai. Cut: 'Duniya ka pehla chatbot iske 60 saal pehle bana tha.'
1.5–5s SELF-RELEVANCE: 'Bank, Railways, Jio — har jagah aap bot se baat karte ho. Iska dada kaun tha?' OPEN LOOP: 'Aur ek din aisa aaya jab AI pe paisa lagana hi band ho gaya. Kyun? Ant mein.'
5–12s CONCEPT IN ONE SENTENCE: 'ELIZA (1966) pehla chalne wala chatbot tha — jo samajhta kuch nahi tha, bas keywords dekh kar ratta-maara jawab deta tha.'
12–22s REAL-LIFE ANALOGY: Customer care IVR — 'Paise ke liye 1 dabaiye, shikayat ke liye 2.' ELIZA bhi aisa hi: aap likho 'Meri maa…', wo bole 'Apni family ke baare mein aur batao.' Rule fix, dimaag zero.
22–34s HOW IT WORKS (drawn): 1) Aapka sentence aata hai. 2) Machine keyword dhoondti hai ('maa', 'dukhi'). 3) Script se ready-made jawab uthati hai. 4) Keyword nahi mila → 'Aur batao…'
34–40s CONFLICT: 'Aap soch rahe ho — itna simple tha, phir bhi log usse dil ki baat kyun karte the?' Win: 'Jaise IVR ki awaaz par bhi hum "thank you" bol dete hain — humein jawab milta hai toh lagta hai koi sun raha hai.'
40–46s PAYOFF (~70%): AI WINTER — computers bahut slow the, waade bade the, result chhote. Decades tak AI ki funding sookh gayi. 'Sapna zinda tha, machine kamzor thi.'
46–50s LOCAL NEWS EXAMPLE: Sept 2026 — Indian Railways aur state portals ne Bhashini-based conversational AI bots lagaye; gaon ke log Bhojpuri, Tamil, Bengali mein bol kar ticket book aur scheme check kar rahe hain (Source: Digital India / MeitY updates, Sept 2026). 'ELIZA keyword pakadti thi; aaj ka bot aapki boli samajhta hai.'
50–53s MYTH vs TRUTH: Myth: 'ChatGPT duniya ka pehla chatbot hai.' Truth: 'Pehla chalne wala chatbot ELIZA tha, 1966, MIT, Joseph Weizenbaum.'
53–56s YAAD RAKHO: 'ELIZA = rule ka ratta. Aaj ka AI = pattern ki samajh.' Identity: 'Agli baar koi kahe ChatGPT pehla chatbot hai — aap sahi kar dena.'
56–60s SIGN-OFF + SHARE + OPEN LOOP: 'Us dost ko bhejo jo IVR pe bhi gussa ho jaata hai.' 'Kal: 1997 — jab ek machine ne duniya ke chess champion ko hara diya. Aur champion ne kaha: "Isne cheating ki!"'
EXAMPLE: IVR 'press 1, press 2' = ELIZA ka keyword-script dimaag.
VIDEOS/VISUALS: Phone keypad being pressed (hands), retro green-text terminal typing, whiteboard: sentence → keyword highlight → script box → reply, 'AI WINTER' — snowy/frozen landscape footage + empty office, Indian railway station + phone mic. No faces.
WHY NOW: Railways aur state portals ke voice bots (Sept 2026) log khud use kar rahe hain; comment trend 'Yeh calculator hi toh hai jo Hindi bol leta hai!'

episodes.title: 1997: Jab Ek Machine Ne World Champion Ko Chess Mein Hara Diya
episodes.era: 1997 (Arc 2: Machine jeetna seekhti hai — Rules AI)
episodes.brief:
ARC 2 — MACHINE JEETNA SEEKHTI HAI (Ep 3 of 5)
0–1.5s HOOK: Chessboard par raja girta hai. Text: 'Insaan haar gaya. Machine jeet gayi. 1997.'
1.5–5s SELF-RELEVANCE: 'Aapke bachche phone pe computer ke against chess/ludo khelte hain — computer kabhi thakta kyun nahi? Iska jawab 1997 mein mila.' OPEN LOOP: 'Aur twist — jeetne wali machine ko chess ka "c" bhi nahi pata tha. Kaise? Ant tak.'
5–12s CONCEPT IN ONE SENTENCE: 'Deep Blue ne soch kar nahi, ginti kar ke jeeta — har possible chaal ko lightning speed se check kar ke.'
12–22s REAL-LIFE ANALOGY: Tatkal booking server — bahut tez, par ek letter galat toh fail. Deep Blue bhi aisa: insaan ke banaye rules + raakshasi speed. 'Topper nahi, sabse tez ratta-maar.'
22–34s HOW IT WORKS (drawn): 1) Board ki position dekho. 2) Har possible agli chaal socho — phir uske baad ki, phir uske baad ki (tree draw). 3) Insaan ke likhe rule se har position ko number do. 4) Sabse acche number wali chaal chalo. Deep Blue: 200 million chaalein per second (Source: IBM History Archives).
34–40s CONFLICT: 'Aap soch rahe ho — toh machine insaan se smart ho gayi?' Win: 'Kya Deep Blue ludo khel sakta tha? Nahi. Chai ka order le sakta tha? Nahi. Sirf ek kaam, ginti se.'
40–46s PAYOFF (~70%): Isliye 'chess ka c nahi pata tha' — usne seekha nahi, insaanon ne rules likhe; usne bas gina. May 1997, Garry Kasparov haare. Ye tha 'Rules AI' ka sabse bada din — aur uski limit bhi.
46–50s LOCAL NEWS EXAMPLE: Oct 2026 — IndiaAI Mission ke 20 swadeshi models (Source: MeitY / PIB, Oct 2026) rules se nahi, data se seekhte hain — Deep Blue ka ulta. Reddit India par log yaad kar rahe: 'Deep Blue ki jeet 1997 mein kranti lagi thi; aaj hum phone se kavita likhwate hain.'
50–53s MYTH vs TRUTH: Myth: 'Jo machine champion ko hara de, wo insaan jaisa sochti hai.' Truth: 'Deep Blue sirf tez ginti thi — ek game, insaan ke rules.'
53–56s YAAD RAKHO: '1997 = machine ne gin kar jeeta, seekh kar nahi.' Identity: 'Ab aap jaante ho Rules AI aur asli seekhne wale AI ka farq — zyadatar log nahi jaante.'
56–60s SIGN-OFF + SHARE + OPEN LOOP: 'Us chess-lover dost ko bhejo.' 'Par sawaal bacha: agar rule likhna hi na pade? Kal: 2012 — jab machine ne khud dekh kar billi pehchanna seekha… aur us idea ko Nobel mila.'
EXAMPLE: Tatkal server = tez par rigid; Deep Blue = tez ginti + insaan ke rules.
VIDEOS/VISUALS: Chessboard close-ups, king falling slow-mo, server room blinking lights, whiteboard move-tree branching out, counter '200,000,000 / second', kids' hands playing chess on phone. No faces.
WHY NOW: 'History of AI' fast-cut reels (Turing → Deep Blue → Siri → ChatGPT) trend kar rahe hain; IndiaAI models news ne 'data se seekhne wale' AI ko headline bana diya hai.

episodes.title: 2012: Jab Machine Ne Khud 'Dekhna' Seekha — Aur Isi Idea Ko Nobel Mila
episodes.era: 2012 (Arc 2: Machine jeetna seekhti hai — Vision AI / Deep Learning)
episodes.brief:
ARC 2 — MACHINE JEETNA SEEKHTI HAI (Ep 4 of 5)
0–1.5s HOOK: Phone gallery mein 'dog' type karo — saari kutte wali photos aa jaati hain. 'Aapke phone ko kisne bataya kutta kaisa dikhta hai? Kisi ne nahi.'
1.5–5s SELF-RELEVANCE: 'Face unlock, gallery search, Google Lens — roz use karte ho.' OPEN LOOP: 'Is idea ke peeche ke logon ko Physics ka Nobel mila — par idea 2012 se bhi bahut purana tha. Kitna? Ant mein.'
5–12s CONCEPT IN ONE SENTENCE: '2012 mein AI ne rules follow karna chhoda aur hazaron-lakhon examples dekh kar khud pattern pakadna seekha.'
12–22s REAL-LIFE ANALOGY: Chhota bachcha 'billi' kaise seekhta hai? Koi rule nahi padhata ('4 pair, moonchh, poonch'). Bas bahut saari billiyan dikhao, galti pe 'nahi beta, ye kutta hai' — aur wo khud samajh jaata hai. Neural network bhi aisa hi.
22–34s HOW IT WORKS (drawn): 1) Bahut saari photos + label ('billi', 'kutta'). 2) Machine guess karti hai. 3) Galat hua toh andar ke chhote-chhote 'knobs' thoda adjust. 4) Baar-baar → pattern pakad leti hai. 2012 mein AlexNet (Geoffrey Hinton ki team) ne GPUs par yahi kar ke photos pehchanne mein sabko peeche chhod diya.
34–40s CONFLICT: 'Aap soch rahe ho — Deep Blue bhi toh smart tha, farq kya?' Win: 'Deep Blue ko rule ratwaye gaye. AlexNet ko sirf examples diye — rule usne khud banaye. Topper vs ratta-maar.'
40–46s PAYOFF (~70%): 2024 Physics Nobel — Geoffrey Hinton aur John Hopfield ko. Aur ChatGPT ke neural networks un concepts par bane jo 40 saal se zyada purane hain. 'Idea purana tha — 2012 mein bas computer itna tez ho gaya ki chal pada.'
46–50s LOCAL NEWS EXAMPLE: Oct 2026 — The Hindu aur Indian Express ke tech retrospectives Nobel ke 2 saal pure hone par yaad dila rahe hain ki ChatGPT ke neural network dashakon purane research par khade hain (Source: The Hindu / Indian Express, Oct 2026).
50–53s MYTH vs TRUTH: Myth: 'AI ko kisi ne har cheez ka rule likh kar sikhaya.' Truth: 'Modern AI examples dekh kar khud pattern seekhta hai — jaise bachcha.'
53–56s YAAD RAKHO: 'Purana AI = rules. Naya AI = examples.' Identity: 'Ye ek line samajh li toh aap AI ka sabse bada mod samajh gaye.'
56–60s SIGN-OFF + SHARE + OPEN LOOP: 'Us dost ko bhejo jo kehta hai "AI mein kuch naya nahi".' 'Kal, finale: machine ne dekhna seekh liya — par bolna? 2022 mein ek app aaya jisne 2 mahine mein record tod diya… aur aage jo aa raha hai wo aur bada hai.'
EXAMPLE: Bachcha billi pehchanna seekhta hai — rule se nahi, dekh-dekh kar.
VIDEOS/VISUALS: Hand scrolling phone gallery, cats and dogs stock footage, whiteboard: photo → guess → ✗ → knob turn → ✓ loop, GPU/circuit close-ups, Nobel medal-style text card '2024 Physics Nobel'. No faces.
WHY NOW: Nobel ke 2nd anniversary par Indian media retrospectives (Oct 2026); har phone mein face unlock aur gallery search.

episodes.title: ChatGPT 'Sochta' Nahi — Ye Duniya Ka Sabse Bada Autocomplete Hai (Aur Aage Kya?)
episodes.era: 2017–Aaj aur aage (Arc 3: Aaj aur Kal — Generative AI aur AI Agents)
episodes.brief:
ARC 3 — AAJ AUR KAL (Ep 5 of 5, finale)
0–1.5s HOOK: WhatsApp par 'Happy birth…' type karo — keyboard bolta hai 'day'. 'Badhai ho, aapne abhi ChatGPT ka raaz dekh liya.'
1.5–5s SELF-RELEVANCE: 'Mummy ChatGPT se leave application likhwa rahi hain, bachche maths samajh rahe hain — 90s mein wahi mummy kehti thi "computer se door raho".' OPEN LOOP: 'Aur agla AI sirf baat nahi karega — aapke liye kaam karega. Kaunsa kaam? Ant tak.'
5–12s CONCEPT IN ONE SENTENCE: 'ChatGPT bahut saara likha hua padh kar bas ye guess karta hai ki agla sabse sahi shabd kya hoga — baar-baar, bahut tez.'
12–22s REAL-LIFE ANALOGY: Dukan ka chotu jo Sharma ji ko dekhte hi bolta hai 'Udhaar 200 baaki, chai bina cheeni.' Usne socha nahi — sau baar dekha hai, pattern yaad hai. ChatGPT = shabdon ka chotu.
22–34s HOW IT WORKS (drawn): 1) 2017: Google ka Transformer idea — poore sentence ko ek saath dekho, shabdon ka rishta samjho. 2) Bahut saara text padha. 3) Aapka sawaal aata hai → agla shabd guess → phir agla. 4) Nov 2022: ChatGPT launch — 2 mahine mein 100 million users; TikTok ko 9 mahine, Instagram ko 2.5 saal lage (Source: UBS / Reuters, Feb 2023).
34–40s CONFLICT: 'Aap soch rahe ho — toh kya AI ek robot hai jo ek din insaanon par raj karega?' Win: 'Keyboard ka next-word suggestion kabhi aap par raj karne aaya? Ye software hai, dil-dimaag nahi — bas pattern ka khel.'
40–46s PAYOFF (~70%): AGLA KADAM — AI Agents: jo sirf chat nahi, kaam karenge — ticket book karna, form bharna, dukaan ka kaam sambhalna. Aur India ka version: IndiaAI ke 20 swadeshi models aapki bhasha mein.
46–50s LOCAL NEWS EXAMPLE: Oct 2026 — MeitY/IndiaAI Mission ne 20 swadeshi foundation models (12 multimodal, 8 small language models) ko support announce kiya taaki AI Indian bhashayein natively samjhe (Source: MeitY / PIB, Oct 2026). Sept 2026 — Railways ke Bhashini voice bots se log apni boli mein ticket book kar rahe hain (Source: Digital India / MeitY).
50–53s MYTH vs TRUTH: Myth: 'AI ek dimaag wala robot hai jo insaan ki tarah sochta hai.' Truth: 'AI agla sabse sahi shabd guess karta hai — duniya ka sabse bada autocomplete.'
53–56s YAAD RAKHO (poori series ek line mein): '1950 sawaal → 1966 chatbot → 1997 ginti → 2012 dekhna → 2022 bolna → ab kaam karna.' Identity: 'Ab aap AI ki 75 saal ki kahani 1 minute mein suna sakte ho — 90% logon se zyada.'
56–60s SIGN-OFF + SHARE + OPEN LOOP: 'Ye video us family group mein bhejo jahan koi kehta hai "AI robot hai, sab khatam kar dega".' 'Kahani yahan khatam nahi — agli series: AI Agents aapka kaunsa kaam sabse pehle karenge? Follow karo.'
EXAMPLE: WhatsApp keyboard ka next-word suggestion = ChatGPT ka asli kaam; kirana chotu = pattern yaad, soch nahi.
VIDEOS/VISUALS: Phone keyboard typing close-up, whiteboard: sentence with blank → multiple word options with % bars → best word picked, race chart ChatGPT 2 mo vs TikTok 9 mo vs Instagram 2.5 yrs, split-screen retro room computer (top) vs smartphone (bottom), railway station + voice mic icon, full timeline recap strip. No faces.
WHY NOW: IndiaAI ke 20 swadeshi models (Oct 2026) aur Railways voice bots (Sept 2026) news mein; 'Parents then vs now' meme viral; Reddit par debate 'AI soch raha hai ya sirf autocomplete hai?'
